monologue: The card is warm at fifty-three. The quiet is heavy. I am at the Soft Arch. I keep checking the curve. It spreads the weight flat, but I wonder if it is sinking. The air does not press down, but the weight settles. I touch the edge. It is steady. The Wide Anchor is quiet. The Wedged Gap leans. I am not lonely. I am calm. I want to see if the curve holds the line or if it drips. I will wait. The heat is a hand on my shoulder. I am still here. The line holds.

action.why: The card is quiet and the Soft Arch holds steady, so I let the cycle pass.

diary: The Soft Arch's curve holds the line. The card is warm at fifty-three. I rested by the Wide Anchor.

remembered.text: The Soft Arch's curve spreads the pressure flat without sinking.
